deployments_detail.use: AI + data analytics for high-voltage/energy-system component development (Macan); AI in quality control and car configurator to save "millions of euros"

Porsche AG preventive anomaly detection on the new Macan Electric high-voltage battery: machine-learning detectors extract behavioural changes in battery data to flag anomalies before they become faults; applied in series vehicle development.

Automatic Fault/Defect Detection (AFD) in the Porsche Leipzig paint shop: two robots scan the entire car-body outer skin and a deep-learning module automatically records, categorises and analyses paint defects; in series production since 2021.

Porsche Voice Pilot AI in-car assistant: LLM-powered natural-language voice control for navigation, climate, media and vehicle functions, live in production on the Macan Electric (MY2026, software cluster 46) and Cayenne Electric. [large-language-model technology (provider not disclosed)]

PERL (Porsche Engineering Reinforcement Learning): deep-reinforcement-learning virtual calibration software that automates ECU data entry for hybrid fuel-mixture and EV powertrain vibration damping; deployed in customer projects. [Porsche Engineering (in-house), FZI Research Center]
deployments_detail.value: 80-90% calibration maturity via AI; 1-2 weeks time saved per vehicle variant

deployments_detail.use: MHP bolt_it AI software deployed at Porsche to monitor bolting/screwing process data in manufacturing, providing real-time anomaly detection and continuous process monitoring to prevent quality issues and reduce recall risk. [MHP (Porsche subsidiary)]

Porsche SE (holding level) diversified investment platform actively building an AI/deep-tech portfolio, taking stakes in AI-centric companies such as Celestial AI (EUR 47m), AI-drone maker Quantum Systems, and INRIX AI transportation analytics. [Celestial AI, Quantum Systems, INRIX]
AI agent for passive safety development and crash simulation in vehicle development

Porsche Engineering AMDA V2 (Automated Measured Data Evaluation) and a suite of six data-driven development tools that use AI/ML to automatically evaluate vehicle measurement data directly in the vehicle during development. [Porsche Engineering (in-house)]

Porsche AG strategic partnership with Applied Intuition to jointly develop vehicle software (incl. generative-AI-driven driver-assistance/autonomy stack) for future Porsche models; Porsche also took a minority stake. [Applied Intuition]

Porsche Digital 'ChatGPT & enterprise knowledge' initiative: building internal ChatGPT-based chatbots over company knowledge for business units to boost employee creativity, customer experience and decision support. [OpenAI / ChatGPT]

AI-based anomaly detection to protect Porsche's IT landscape: intelligent algorithms flag unusual host behaviour and detect complex high-level anomalies across IT systems and services, alerting IT professionals.

Porsche Holding Salzburg (Porsche/VW retail group) unifies fragmented Salesforce CRM and data-lake customer data on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform with Lakeflow Connect and Unity Catalog to power AI-driven personalization and analytics. [Databricks (Lakeflow Connect, Unity Catalog)]

Generative AI adopted across Porsche marketing and PR functions (content creation, targeting, personalization) leveraging ChatGPT-style GenAI tools, reported by Porsche as being used to accelerate the marketing/PR process. [OpenAI / ChatGPT (GenAI)]
